div.div:
The endpoint runs the assignment's fixed equality check against configured strings (APP_USER_USERNAME / APP_USER_PASSWORD from the gitignored .env; defaults user / password in dev/test).
It is separate from the BCrypt in-memory store used by HTTP Basic (user/user123 · admin/admin123) and from JWT role mapping. Token expiry is 3,600,000 ms (1 h) in dev/test profiles.
